observation: Final acceptance now requires the exact accepted ClayVerse image digest behind an independent VM/microVM guest-kernel envelope, but the canonical Kata StatefulSet template contains no NetworkPolicy. hostNetwork=false does not itself isolate normal pod ingress/egress.
primary_evidence: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy docs: pods are non-isolated for ingress and egress unless selecting policies apply; default-deny policies isolate directions.
Kubernetes docs: default-deny egress also blocks DNS and requires an explicit DNS allowance if DNS is needed.
Kubernetes docs: standard NetworkPolicy is L3/L4 and cannot enforce TLS semantics or target services by name.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Adding a broad HTTPS allow rule would restore functionality but would violate the controlled-egress intent because standard NetworkPolicy cannot bind that rule to Clerk/Anthropic/GLM identities.
decision: Implement a single retained source lane whose reference deployment is default-deny for both directions and requires explicit provider/cluster-specific ingress and egress allow policies plus enforcement attestation before final acceptance.
